## Teaching points

1. Normal oxygen saturation can coexist with neuromuscular respiratory weakness. Obtain serial respiratory mechanics and involve the ICU early.
2. Assess bulbar protection and serial respiratory mechanics; early ICU/neurology involvement is more useful than waiting for hypoxemia.
3. The engine lacks FVC/NIF, ventilation, IVIG and plasma exchange. Handoff must request these assessments and therapies rather than claiming they were simulated.
